assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I49.5.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the intermittent syncope and correlate it with the documented arrhythmias.
